problem.title: K-th Lexicographical Happy String
problem.problemStatement: A happy string consists only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c', with no two adjacent characters being equal. Given integers N and K, determine the K-th lexicographically smallest happy string of length N. If fewer than K happy strings exist, print an empty string.
problem.input: • First line contains integers N and K.
